$comment: Fixed iteration set for the lab: 32 dev-split cases (never test), 4 per profile: an English clear positive, a French positive, a look-alike negative, and one rotating extra (subtle positive, hard case or negative); short and medium texts only so one chunk covers each case. 22 positives, 10 negatives. Picked deterministically by sha256('iter-v1:' + id) order.
